query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Implement and release a protected budget dashboard feature by reading Google Sheets and Google Docs data, retrieving deployment secrets from Vercel, committing and merging code changes, verifying deployments, and updating a Jira issue.
query_ground_truth.intent: Fetch necessary environment variables and secret credentials from Vercel for the build.

requirement_groups.purpose: Retrieve deployment secrets and environment variables from Vercel

results.execution_guidance: Found 3 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Vercel is a platform for frontend frameworks and static sites, enabling developers to host websites and web services that deploy instantly, scale automatically, and require minimal configuration.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=vercel. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="vercel") to create a connection BEFORE executing any vercel tools.

VERCEL_GET_PROJECT_ENV.description: Tool to retrieve the decrypted value of an environment variable from a Vercel project. Use when you need to access the actual value of a specific environment variable by its ID.

id.description: The unique ID for the environment variable to get the decrypted value.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

VERCEL_FILTER_PROJECT_ENVS.description: Tool to retrieve environment variables of a Vercel project by id or name. Use when you need to list and filter environment variables for a specific project.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

source.description: The source that is calling the endpoint

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

decrypt.description: If true, the environment variable value will be decrypted

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

gitBranch.description: If defined, the git branch of the environment variable to filter the results (must have target=preview)

customEnvironmentId.description: The unique custom environment identifier within the project

customEnvironmentSlug.description: The custom environment slug (name) within the project

VERCEL_EDIT_PROJECT_ENV.description: Tool to edit an environment variable in a Vercel project. Use when you need to update an existing environment variable's value, type, target environments, or other properties. Requires both the project identifier and the environment variable ID.

key.description: The name of the environment variable

slug.description: Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

value.description: The value of the environment variable

target.description: The target environment of the environment variable. Must be provided as a list even for a single environment

teamId.description: Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

comment.description: A comment to add context on what this env var is for

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

gitBranch.description: If defined, the git branch of the environment variable (must have target=preview)

customEnvironmentIds.description: The custom environments that the environment variable should be synced to. Must be provided as a list even for a single ID
